'''Chikorita's Saint Valentine''' (Japanese: '''チコのｓｔバレンタインの巻''', ''{{tt|Chico|Chiko}}'s St. Valentine''), is the third chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey volume 8|eighth volume]] of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Chiko]] wants to make Valentine's Day chocolate for [[Almond]], but she's no good at it. And is it really Almond her heart is set on?
